name: catalyst
description: Research-driven development workflow with Linear integration, PM tools, and infrastructure research agents — Codex plugin catalog.

plugins.name: catalyst-dev
plugins.description: Complete development workflow: research → plan → implement → validate → ship. Includes research agents, planning tools, handoff system, Linear integration, and PM commands.

plugins.name: catalyst-pm
plugins.description: Product strategy toolkit — PRDs, strategy docs, priorities, and release planning

plugins.name: catalyst-analytics
plugins.description: Product analytics with PostHog MCP integration. Enable when analyzing user behavior, conversion metrics, and product usage. ~40k context tokens when enabled.

plugins.name: catalyst-debugging
plugins.description: Production error monitoring with Sentry MCP integration. Enable when debugging errors, analyzing stack traces, and investigating incidents. ~20k context tokens when enabled.

plugins.name: catalyst-meta
plugins.description: Workflow discovery, creation, reorganization, and audit tools: learn from community patterns, extend Catalyst with new workflows, safely reorganize directory structures, and audit plugin health.

plugins.name: catalyst-pm-ops
plugins.description: Linear cycle/backlog/PR ops, daily and weekly cadence, status updates, and team comms — extracted from catalyst-pm

plugins.name: catalyst-meeting-hygiene
plugins.description: Meeting workflow skills: agenda creation, transcript processing, end-of-day batch cleanup, and effectiveness retros — extracted from catalyst-pm

plugins.name: catalyst-discovery
plugins.description: User research, metrics, experimentation, and prototyping skills — the discovery/research companion to catalyst-pm

plugins.name: catalyst-legacy
plugins.description: Pre-phase-agent (wave-based) orchestration workflow preserved as a documented fallback: oneshot, orchestrate, god, setup-orchestrate. Superseded by catalyst-dev's execution-core/phase-agent pipeline. Requires catalyst-dev (shared backing scripts).

plugins.name: catalyst-foundry
plugins.description: Setup, maintenance, and compounding upkeep of the Catalyst framework and the thoughts/ knowledge base: framework diagnostics/repair (setup-catalyst), terminal launcher config (setup-warp), and research-doc curation (research-curate). Future home for the compound-engineering retro/learning loop.
